description:
Good Fix Validation Runner practice is not talent - it is handoff protocol. It turns Fix Validation Runner from an event into a repeatable capability.

Concretely: verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes; keep a failure log: what broke, why, and what now prevents it; review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done This record exists because the difference between a tool and a capability is discipline. Run the demo, adopt the checklist, and Fix Validation Runner becomes something your builds can rely on.
